content: PostHog Next.js App Router setup (2026): Install posthog-js@1.391.2 (latest) + posthog-node for server-side. Current recommended pattern uses instrumentation-client.ts at root (supported since Next.js 15.3, works in 16): posthog.init(NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN, { api_host: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST, defaults: '2026-01-30' }). For pageviews in SPA navigation, create a PageviewTracker client component using usePathname + useSearchParams that calls posthog.capture('') on route change — CRITICAL: wrap this component in <Suspense fallback={null}> in the layout, because useSearchParams() requires a Suspense boundary in App Router or build fails with 'missing-suspense-with-csr-bailout'. Guard with posthog.__loaded before firing. The @posthog/next package is pre-release and not recommended for production yet. For this MVP: posthog-node is not needed (no server-side events needed — only client funnel events: start, parse_done, letter_done, copy_download).
